svg.title: Sermorelin in healthy older adults: blood tests moved, function mostly didn't
svg.desc: Sermorelin in healthy older adults: blood tests moved, function mostly didn't. Raises growth hormone and IGF-1: Yes. Several small studies, incl. 2 weeks in 10 older men. Lean mass and body fat: Small change. Lean mass up, fat down (6-month trial, early report). Muscle strength and aerobic fitness: No gain. No improvement in the 6-month placebo trial. Deep sleep: No gain. Failed to improve, and may have impaired it. Thinking tests: Small gain. One placebo trial of 89 adults; not yet repeated with sermorelin. Long-term safety in healthy adults: Unknown. We found no trial longer than 6 months.
